title: The Friend Who Never Competed With You
body:
Success changes many things.

New opportunities.
New environments.
New circles of people.

But sometimes the most impressive person is the friend who remains humble through all of it.

The one who still laughs at the same jokes.
The one who still treats everyone with respect.
The one who doesn't let success change their character.

Achievements can change your lifestyle.

They should never change your values.

Because people admire success, but they respect humility.

 "Success becomes meaningful when it doesn't change who you are."
